Your privacy. Our responsibility.

This Privacy Policy explains how OneClicq may collect, use, store and protect information when you visit our website, communicate with us, or use our services.

01

Introduction

OneClicq respects your privacy and is committed to handling information responsibly. This Privacy Policy describes the general practices that may apply when you visit the OneClicq website, submit information through our forms, contact our team, or engage us for technology services.

By using our website or voluntarily providing information to us, you acknowledge that your information may be handled as described in this Privacy Policy.

Important: This policy is intended as general website privacy information. Specific projects or client engagements may be governed by additional contractual terms, data-processing agreements or other applicable documentation.

02

Information We Collect

Depending on how you interact with OneClicq, we may receive information that you choose to provide or information generated through your interaction with our website.

Information you provide

  • Name and contact information.
  • Business email address and phone number.
  • Company or organization information.
  • Project requirements, messages and other information submitted through contact forms.
  • Information you provide when communicating with our team.
  • Job applications sent through our careers form: your name, contact details, location, experience, salary expectation, profile links, cover note and the resume file you upload. Resumes are stored on our server in a folder that is not publicly accessible and are emailed to our hiring team.

Technical information

When you visit our website, certain technical information may be collected automatically by your browser and our hosting environment, such as your IP address, browser type, device information and the pages requested, in standard server logs. We do not currently use analytics or advertising tools on this website.

03

How We Use Information

Information may be used for legitimate business and operational purposes, including:

  • Responding to enquiries and requests.
  • Understanding project requirements.
  • Communicating about potential or existing projects.
  • Providing, maintaining and improving our services.
  • Improving website usability and performance.
  • Protecting our website, systems and users.
  • Meeting applicable legal or contractual obligations.

We aim to use information only for appropriate purposes related to our business operations and the relationship we have with you.

04

Cookies & Tracking Technologies

Our own pages do not set analytics, advertising or tracking cookies. The map on our Contact page is provided by Google Maps, which may set its own cookies, and our hosting provider may use a technical cookie to protect the site from abuse.

Full details are in our Cookie Policy.

Your browser may provide controls that allow you to manage or block certain cookies. Disabling cookies may affect some website functionality.

05

Information Sharing

OneClicq does not intend to sell personal information simply because you visit our website or contact us. Information may, however, be shared when reasonably necessary to operate our business or provide requested services.

Service providers

We may use third-party providers for services such as hosting, infrastructure, communications, analytics, security or other business operations. Such providers may process information only as necessary to perform their relevant services.

Legal and security requirements

Information may also be disclosed when reasonably necessary to comply with applicable law, respond to lawful requests, protect rights or property, or investigate security or abuse concerns.

06

Data Security

We take reasonable measures designed to protect information against unauthorized access, misuse, alteration or disclosure.

However, no website, internet transmission or electronic storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure. For this reason, you should avoid submitting sensitive information through general website forms unless specifically requested through an appropriate secure process.

07

Data Retention

We may retain information for as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it was collected, to maintain business records, provide services, resolve disputes, enforce agreements, or comply with applicable legal obligations.

Actual retention periods may vary depending on the type of information and the circumstances in which it was collected.

08

Your Privacy Rights

Depending on where you live and applicable privacy laws, you may have rights relating to your personal information.

These may include rights to:

  • Request access to certain personal information.
  • Request correction of inaccurate information.
  • Request deletion where applicable.
  • Object to or restrict certain processing where legally available.
  • Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.

Requests should include sufficient information for us to understand and respond to the request. Applicable law may affect the availability or scope of these rights.

09

Children's Privacy

Our website and business services are intended for businesses, professionals and general audiences rather than children.

We do not knowingly seek to collect personal information from children through general website enquiries. If you believe a child has provided personal information to us, please contact us so that the matter can be reviewed appropriately.

10

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our website, services, business practices, technology or applicable requirements.

When changes are made, the updated version will be published on this page. We encourage visitors to review this page periodically.

11

Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or would like to make a privacy-related request, please contact the OneClicq team.
